room_id.description: Unique identifier for each space, traced from ITU Faculty of Architecture floor plans. Numeric for most rooms; alphanumeric for stair landings and specific zones (e.g., 'S_NW', 'CATI_3').

floor.description: Floor level of the space. One of: 'basement', 'ground', 'floor1', 'floor2'.

function_type.description: Primary functional category. One of 18 types: lecture_studio, workshop, archive, laboratory, administrative, office, faculty_room, circulation, research_centre, library, meeting, conference_hall, exhibition_hall, courtyard, wc, institute, virtual_studio, technical_service.

function_detail.description: Specific name or detail of the space as labelled in original plans (e.g., 'Takı Tasarım Atölyesi', 'Süleyman Demirel Konferans Salonu').

area_m2.description: Floor area in square meters, computed from polyline geometry in Grasshopper.

perimeter_m.description: Perimeter length of the space in meters, computed from reconstructed polygon in Python (shapely).

centroid_x.description: X coordinate of the space centroid in the Rhino model coordinate system (meters).

centroid_y.description: Y coordinate of the space centroid in the Rhino model coordinate system (meters).

door_count.description: Number of doors connecting the space to other spaces (corridors, adjacent rooms, exterior). Counted manually from floor plans.

window_count.description: Number of windows opening to the exterior facade or the inner courtyard.

facade_orientation.description: Cardinal/intermediate direction of the primary exterior facade. One of: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, interior.

opens_to.description: Direct spatial connections of this room, recorded as a comma-separated list (e.g., 'corridor', 'room_5,corridor', 'outside'). Used to construct the graph in NetworkX.

nearest_stair_id.description: Identifier of the nearest stair core. One of: S_NW, S_NE, S_SW, S_SE (the four corner stairs of the building).

nearest_stair_distance_m.description: Euclidean distance from the space centroid to the nearest stair landing, in meters.

integration_hh.description: Hillier's Integration HH metric (1 / RRA). Higher values indicate spaces topologically more central in the spatial graph. Computed via NetworkX from the constructed room-door graph.

connectivity.description: Graph-theoretic degree of the node — the number of direct neighbours (rooms connected by a doorway). Higher values indicate more locally connected spaces.

mean_depth.description: Mean depth: average shortest-path distance from this space to all other spaces in the graph. Lower values indicate more accessible spaces.

step_depth_from_entrance.description: Shortest-path distance (BFS) from the main entrance node (#137, Güvenlik) to this space. Range: 0 (entrance itself) to 6 (deepest, most isolated). Used as the basis for walkability scoring.
